title: Regional silence windows and autonomic circuit operator for pager noise reduction
creator: Ava Navarro
description: Reduce noisy paging during predictable regional transient events by combining: 1) configurable region-level silence windows (time-limited, SLO-aware suppression) 2) an autonomic circuit operator that dynamically adjusts circuit-breaker thresholds and load-shedding targets based on recent SLO burn and KV cache hit ratios 3) runbook automation to triage and escalate only when customer-impacting thresholds are met. Goal: 60-80% reduction in non-actionable pages from regional degradation without increasing SLO miss rate for high-value customers.
acceptance_criteria: Region-level silence windows feature implemented in alert router and feature-flagged
Autonomic circuit operator prototype adjusts cb thresholds automatically and exposes decisions in traces
On-call runbook automation triggers a reduced-page playflow and creates a summary incident with suggested mitigation steps
Synthetic/regression tests show >=60% drop in pages for synthetic region spike scenarios while critical-customer SLO breaches still page
Dashboard: per-region pager reduction, SLO burn, CB adjustments, and latency percentiles available in console-ops dashboard
tasks: Design API for defining silence windows per region and per-priority (PM + SRE)
Alert router: implement suppression rules that consider SLO-weighted priority and silence-window exemptions
Build autonomic circuit operator service that ingests SLO telemetry and suggests CB thresholds
Integrate operator decisions into runtime routing with safe-rollback canary and audit log
Create runbook automation templates for: transient region spike, degraded KV cache, and prolonged SLO burn
Add telemetry panels (Grafana): region pager-rate, suppressed events, SLO burn, CB state machine
Run tabletop + simulated failures across 3 regions, capture metrics and on-call feedback
Ship feature-flagged beta to non-critical customers, measure impact for 2 weeks

postmortem_notes: Root cause: transient regional backend GC + KV cache churn causing latency spikes and thresholded alerts that lacked regional context
Why previous mitigations failed: global alert thresholds and static cooldowns paged equally for all regions and priorities
What changed: added region-aware suppression, SLO-weighted paging, and an autonomic operator to tune CBs in response to telemetry
Follow-ups: add tenant-level opt-out in Console, tighten rollback window for operator decisions, extend tests to 5 regions
